data.name: Anisa
data.gender_notes: Anisa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Anisa means 'friendly' or 'gentle', a beautiful name that symbolizes kindness and compassion. The name Anisa carries the meaning “Friendly, Gentle” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Anisa usually hope their child will grow to embody friendly, gentle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A companion of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), known for her kindness and generosity.
data.etymology: Anisa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friendly, Gentle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anisa total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: أنيسة
in_arabic.long_meaning: أنيسة هي اسم علم مؤنث مشتق من الجذر العربي أنس، والذي يعني الرفقة والcompanionship، وقد أستخدم في القرآن الكريم في سورة النساء، وتعني الأنيسة المرأة التي تحب وتحبها، وتعتبر من الأسماء المقدسة في الثقافة الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: انيسہ
in_urdu.meaning: انيسہ ایک پیاری اور محبت کرنے والی خاتون
in_urdu.long_meaning: انيسہ کا مطلب ہے پیار کرنے والی اور پیار کی جانے والی، یہ نام عربی جڑ سے اخذ کیا گیا ہے جو رفاقت اور ساتھی کے معنی میں ہے، اور اس کا استعمال قرآن مجید میں سورہ النساء میں کیا گیا ہے، اور انیسہ کے معنی ہیں پیار کرنے والی خاتون

in_hindi.name: अनीसा
in_hindi.meaning: अनीसा एक प्यारी और प्रेमिका महिला
in_hindi.long_meaning: अनीसा का अर्थ है प्यार करने वाली और प्यार की जाने वाली, यह नाम अरबी जड़ से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है साथी और संगति, और इसका उपयोग कुरान में सूरह अन-निसा में किया गया है, और अनीसा का अर्थ है प्यार करने वाली महिला

in_pashto.name: انیسہ
in_pashto.meaning: انیسہ د یوې مینځي او مینه کوونکې ښځه
in_pashto.long_meaning: انیسہ د پیار کوونکي او پیار شوی ښځي په معنی دی، دا نوم عربي ریښې څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې د ملګرتیا او مرستې په معنی دی، او د قرآن کریم په سوره النисاء کې کارول شوی دی، او انیسہ د پیار کوونکې ښځې په معنی دی

in_english.name: Anisa
in_english.long_meaning: Anisa is a name that means a loving and beloved woman, derived from the Arabic root that means companionship and friendship, and has been used in the Quran in Surah An-Nisa, and Anisa is considered a sacred name in Islamic culture, symbolizing love, kindness, and compassion

data.cultural_impact: The name Anisa carries a sense of warmth, comfort, and hospitality. Historically, Islamic culture values the trait of compassion towards all of humanity. Anisa is a reminder of the importance of being kind and friendly, not only towards loved ones but towards all people, making it an ideal choice for a daughter whose parents aspire to raise a considerate and thoughtful individual.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, Anisa can also be associated with Islam's divine guidance and the spirit of guardianship. The name has spiritual significance as it is mentioned in the Holy Quran where God Almighty describes prophet Moses as "a mercy from Us and a guide (An-Naasiyah) for tribes that were lost and to all those guided [to Us]" (Quran 28:5). This reinforces the concept that being a guide and a merciful being towards others is highly regarded in the Islamic faith and it brings one closer to their spiritual journey.
